svg.aria-label: A code change and two yes/no questions go to Jev in one request. Jev answers 0.79 for contract risk and 0.61 for a test gap. 0.79 clears its 0.7 threshold and 0.61 misses its 0.8 threshold, so OR gives true. AND with the public_api_changed fact from your code gives needs_review = true.
